Your journey, your data.

Privacy notice · 26 October 2026 · SpeedInno

Guest play

You can play without an account. Completion ticks, recent stage results, preferences, downloaded levels, and your current field are stored in this browser or app. Clearing its data or uninstalling can remove those local saves. Manual play needs no purchase or advertisement. Personal results are not a public leaderboard. Optional purchase and ad services operate only when configured and deliberately used; available offers are shown in the time bank.

Optional cloud accounts

When cloud saving is enabled and you choose to sign in, we use your email address to authenticate you. Supabase processes account authentication, session tokens, database storage, and necessary technical service logs. The configured email-delivery provider sends your sign-in codes. We do not use your email for marketing.

DataPurpose
Email, account ID, account creation timeSign-in, account access and deletion
Completed stages, scores, time, ball counts, play mode, selected stage and completion datesCloud progress and personal stage history
Attempt identifiers, stage version, start/expiry datesReliable save retries, stage order and basic abuse checks
IP/device information in infrastructure logsHosting, email delivery, security and service operation; the game does not create advertising profiles

Authentication sessions are stored on your device so you can stay signed in. Account data is transmitted over HTTPS and protected with database access rules. This is not end-to-end encrypted storage. Shared level definitions contain no creator email or player identifier and are reused for all players.

Optional purchases and time bank

Signed-in accounts can hold finite autoplay time. We store credit sources, purchase identifiers, product/version, platform, reservations, active milliseconds consumed, and refunds to synchronize balances and prevent duplicate spending. In configured Android and iPhone editions, RevenueCat processes the game account identifier and store purchase records to verify purchases with Google Play or Apple. We do not send your sign-in email to the purchase SDK. Payment details are handled by your store; the game does not receive card numbers. SDK and store services also process necessary technical/device information under their own privacy notices.

Purchases use your game account at checkout. Recovery synchronizes the existing balance and does not refill consumed time. When services are unavailable, manual play and device saving continue. Purchase or reward callbacks alone do not prove a financial credit.

Offline saves and importing progress

Your device can queue completed stages while disconnected. Downloads are needed before an account's new cloud stages can be played offline. Guest progress can be linked to an account when you choose to import it. Sign-out returns to a separate guest save; each account has its own local save. Imported history is personal, client-reported progress, not a verified competitive ranking.

Retention and deletion

Cloud progress stays with your account until you delete it or ask support to resolve a data request. Attempt records expire after seven days; completion history remains until account deletion. You can export your cloud history from Account on the web game.

Use Account → Delete my account to delete your authentication identity and associated private progress and balance from the live service. You may need a fresh sign-in code. The local save for that account is removed as well. Minimal provider transaction identifiers, product, quantity and financial status remain after deletion to prevent repeated credit and handle refunds; their game account reference is removed. These transaction tombstones do not currently have an automatic expiry. Provider purchase/account records have their own retention and deletion processes; contact support for assistance. Shared stage designs remain. Provider backup copies, if configured, expire according to the operator's backup schedule rather than being edited immediately.

The account deletion page offers a browser route without reinstalling the app.

Age and audience

Cloud accounts are intended for players who meet the applicable minimum age for online consent where they live. This game does not provide a child-account or parental-consent service. Younger players should use guest play.

Your requests

For access, correction, deletion, export, or privacy questions, contact support. Do not post passwords, sign-in codes, or private account details in a public issue.
